title: The Menu, Week 4
dek: Three starting quarterbacks and five lead backs are off the menu, Kenneth Walker III is RB3, Jaylen Warren is a top-10 back on Thursday night, and Jayden Daniels sits outside the top 24 until he practices.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Wed 11:20 AM ET: Rachaad White carries a flag after sitting out Wednesday's session with the shoulder, Jalen McMillan is on IR so Emeka Egbuka and Chris Godwin are the whole TB receiver room, and CHI starts Tyson Bagent vs NYJ if he practices all week. The order is this morning's: Kenneth Walker III at RB3, Jaylen Warren at RB10, Jaxon Smith-Njigba the WR1, and Marcus Mariota as the WAS quarterback with Jayden Daniels outside the top 24 after a limited jog-through in London. Puka Nacua, Justin Jefferson and Mike Evans sit outside the ranked depth until they practice; Prep Notes brings them back Friday if they do.

Week 4 has no byes and a lot of empty chairs. Caleb Williams, Baker Mayfield and Jaxson Dart are out at quarterback, De'Von Achane and Jordan Mason are on IR, Travis Etienne is out for Monday night, Rico Dowdle has not practiced on a short week, and Breece Hall is week to week. Every one of them has a pivot listed under Off the Menu. Rankings are for full PPR.

The biggest moves come from the snap counts, not the box scores. Warren is a top-10 back with 90 percent of the snaps and 20 touches in Dowdle's absence before Thursday's game at CLE. Chuba Hubbard and Aaron Jones Sr. are RB2s on deployment: 20 carries and every first-half snap for Hubbard, 78 percent of Minnesota's carries for Jones against the defense that has allowed the most points to running backs. Omarion Hampton lost his passing downs, Emeka Egbuka and Chris Godwin have an undrafted rookie at quarterback, and Brian Thomas Jr. is playing 37 percent of the snaps.

Nico Collins carries a flag at WR15: he has not practiced since the hamstring and needs a session by Friday. Prep Notes revisits every flag Friday after the final injury report and updates this page.
outro_md: Tiers are courses. The top of a tier is the safest plate; the bottom is where the flags live. A questionable player keeps his action and carries the flag until Friday. Specials are matchup plays outside the top tiers, and Off the Menu names the pivot for every player who is out.
